layout.tagline: chores for everyone who lives together
layout.buttonFallback: Button not working? Copy the link into your browser:
layout.taskNote: You received this email because you are a member of a group in Errandly

verifyEmail.subject: Verify your email for Errandly
verifyEmail.preheader: One click and you can start gathering your flatmates.
verifyEmail.heading: hi, {{name}}!
verifyEmail.paragraph1: Thanks for signing up for Errandly. There’s one step left: confirm that this is your email.
verifyEmail.paragraph2: Once verified, you can create a group for your flat or room and invite your flatmates.
verifyEmail.note: If you didn’t sign up for Errandly, just ignore this email.

resetPassword.subject: Reset your Errandly password
resetPassword.preheader: The link for a new password is valid for 1 hour.
resetPassword.heading: new password
resetPassword.paragraph1: {{name}}, we received a request to change the password for your account.
resetPassword.paragraph2: The link is valid for 1 hour and works only once.
resetPassword.note: Didn’t request this? Do nothing — your password stays the same.

invite.subject: {{inviterName}} invites you to “{{groupName}}”
invite.preheader: Errandly splits household chores fairly between flatmates.
invite.heading: you’re invited!
invite.paragraph1: {{inviterName}} invites you to the group “{{groupName}}” in Errandly.
invite.paragraph2: Errandly splits household chores so that everyone’s workload is even, and adds them to your Google Calendar. No more arguing about whose turn it is to take out the trash.
invite.paragraph3: The invitation is valid for 7 days.
invite.note: Don’t know who this is? Just ignore this email — you won’t be added to the group unless you follow the link.

taskAssigned.subject: New task: {{taskTitle}}
taskAssigned.heading: your turn!
taskAssigned.paragraph1: {{name}}, you’ve been assigned a task in the group “{{groupName}}”. The system picked you because you have the lowest workload over the last 4 weeks.

taskDueSoon.subject: Reminder: {{taskTitle}} at {{time}}
taskDueSoon.preheader: Less than {{duration}} left until the due date.
taskDueSoon.heading: due soon
taskDueSoon.paragraph1: {{name}}, a reminder: the task is due in less than {{duration}}.
taskDueSoon.paragraph2: Once it’s done, mark the task as done so everyone can see.

taskOverdue.subject: Overdue: {{taskTitle}}
taskOverdue.preheader: The task is past its due date and hasn’t been marked as done.
taskOverdue.heading: oops, overdue
taskOverdue.paragraph1: {{name}}, the task is past its due date and still isn’t marked as done.
taskOverdue.paragraph2: Already done? Mark it — it takes a second. Running late? Agree on a new date with the group admin.
